backfill_note: The experiment ran on 2026-06-17 inside an isolated Docker container (postgres:19beta1). The container and the pulled image were removed after the run per the finite-disk policy; only firsthand-benchmark.md survived (this predates packaging, so no SQL fixtures or hashes were captured at the time). fixture/*.sql + run.sh are reconstructed from that recorded methodology so a third party can reproduce the METHOD against the same pinned image. The findings are deterministic capability/limit observations (a syntax accepts or errors; a command exists or not; a GUC has a fixed default), so re-running against postgres:19beta1 should reproduce them. Production Cloud SQL was never touched.

environment.os: Windows 11 x64 host, Docker Desktop; PostgreSQL under test runs inside the container
environment.container: docker run --name pg19test postgres:19beta1 (isolated, production DB untouched)
environment.note: This is a feature/syntax capability + limit check (does CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH parse, does a quantifier error, does REPACK exist, what is a GUC default) plus a couple of behavior observations. It is NOT a throughput/latency benchmark; host CPU/RAM do not change the accept/error or the default values.

subject.name: PostgreSQL
subject.note: Beta 1. SELECT version() -> 'PostgreSQL 19beta1 (Debian 19~beta1-1.pgdg13+1) ... gcc 14.2.0, 64-bit'. Syntax, extension/library names, and GUC defaults MAY change before GA.

data_source.name: none (local container, synthetic fixtures)
data_source.note: No external live database. Small synthetic tables (person/knows graph, a 200k-row fact + 1k-row dim for the planner probe). Nothing drifts between runs given the same pinned image.

raw_artifacts.retention_policy: discarded at run time (finite local disk)
raw_artifacts.note: Container + pulled image removed after the run; no hashes were captured at the time. Reconstructed harness (run.sh + fixture/*.sql) is committed instead of fabricating artifacts, and that is stated plainly. results.json holds the capabilities, limits, and the two behavior observations recorded on 2026-06-17.
